definitionZh: 将小写字母缩放到小写和大写之间的中间大小,如中世纪手稿中用于句子开口时的放大小写. 将x高和字符宽度从0(默认小写)持续调整到100(完全扩大)。
sourceDefinition: Scales lowercase letters to an intermediate size between minuscule and majuscule, as used in medieval manuscripts for enlarged minuscules at sentence openings. Adjusts x-height and character width continuously from 0 (default lowercase) to 100 (fully enlarged).
